themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis This Week
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 35 THIS WEEK versus 8.8 weekly average—a 300% surge—while simultaneously street sign complaints hit 3 this week versus 0.6 baseline, suggesting rapid deterioration of streetscape infrastructure across CD316.
evidence: Street condition complaints: 35 THIS WEEK vs 8.8 weekly average (z-score 5.18, 300% spike)
Street sign - missing complaints: 3 THIS WEEK vs 0.6 weekly average (z-score 4.91, 380% spike)
Both signals emerged in identical timeframe, suggesting coordinated or cascading infrastructure failure
reporting_angles: Visual street audit: document pothole distribution, missing signage, and sidewalk damage in high-complaint zones
Interview DOT about emergency repair protocols and allocation in Brownsville/Ocean Hill

themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Breakdown Last Week
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints jumped to 13 LAST WEEK from 1.9 weekly average—a 593% spike (z-score 5.18)—indicating potential sanitation service failures or disruption in waste pickup routes across the district.
evidence: Missed collection complaints: 13 LAST WEEK vs 1.9 weekly average (593% spike, z-score 5.18)
Unsanitary condition remains high-volume concern (560 complaints over 90 days), suggesting downstream hygiene impacts
Timing suggests acute service disruption rather than chronic understaffing
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about route changes, staffing absences, or vehicle breakdowns last week
Document resident experiences: missed pickups, overflow, rat activity correlation

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Overload Last Week
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints doubled to 14 LAST WEEK from 4.6 weekly average (203% spike, z-score 4.31), and root/sewer/sidewalk condition complaints hit 4 last week versus 0.6 baseline (540% spike), suggesting subsurface infrastructure stress or flooding event.
evidence: Sewer complaints: 14 LAST WEEK vs 4.6 weekly average (203% spike, z-score 4.31)
Root/sewer/sidewalk condition: 4 LAST WEEK vs 0.6 baseline (540% spike, z-score 4.85)
Water leak complaints remain elevated at 290 over 90 days; paired with sewer spike suggests system-wide stress
reporting_angles: Interview DEP about aging sewer capacity in Brownsville; does system need upgrades given development pressure?
Field reporting: smell, overflow, or drainage issues in neighborhoods where complaints clustered

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage and Overgrowth Cluster 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints hit 3 (1100% spike, z-score 6.35) and overgrown tree/branches hit 4 (700% spike, z-score 4.95) TWO WEEKS AGO, suggesting either severe weather event, delayed response to fallen branches, or illegal tree removal activity.
evidence: Illegal tree damage: 3 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Overgrown tree/branches: 4 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs 0.5 baseline (700% spike, z-score 4.95)
Simultaneous appearance of both tree issues suggests common trigger (weather, contractor activity, or enforcement vacuum)
reporting_angles: Research whether weather event or storm occurred 2 weeks prior; did Parks Dept. respond adequately?
Investigate illegal tree removal claims: interview Parks enforcement about complaints filed

themes_detail.label: Obstruction Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints spiked to 4 LAST WEEK from 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 7.0), indicating blockage of streets, hydrants, or public rights-of-way; unclear whether related to parking, abandoned vehicles, or construction debris.
evidence: Obstruction complaints: 4 LAST WEEK vs 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 7.0, highest severity rating)
Illegal parking remains high-volume concern (872 over 90 days), suggesting obstruction may be vehicle-related
Blocked driveway complaints also elevated (551 over 90 days); may be related subset
reporting_angles: Clarify complaint category: are obstructions vehicles, construction equipment, or debris?
Check NYPD and DOT enforcement data for summons activity last week
